title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1018 | 海牛坐飞机、歪脖子星球、面条长颈鹿
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🛩️ 六只海牛宝宝坐飞机从佛罗里达飞到俄亥俄，Celine 从 48 磅长到 420 磅，足足大了八倍！
🪐 一颗叫 Wasp-17b 的行星歪向一边，一边滚烫一边凉快，温差足足 650 度！
🦒 小长颈鹿 Tambi 的名字在斯瓦希里语里是"面条"，他坐了三千公里长途车搬去珀斯动物园！

📖 Word of the day: lopsided（歪向一边的）

🎮 二选一：跟六只啃生菜的海牛宝宝一起坐飞机，还是去歪脖子星球上一边穿泳衣一边穿羽绒服？你选哪个？也问问爸爸妈妈！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🛩️ Six baby manatees flew from Florida to Ohio, and Celine grew from forty-eight pounds to four hundred twenty pounds!
🪐 Planet Wasp-17b is lopsided — one side is scorching hot, the other is cool, six hundred fifty degrees apart!
🦒 Baby giraffe Tambi, whose name means "noodle" in Swahili, traveled three thousand kilometers across Australia to his new zoo home!

📖 Word of the day: lopsided

🎮 Would you rather: fly on a plane with six lettuce-munching baby manatees, or visit the lopsided planet and pack a swimsuit AND a winter coat?

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. lopsided（歪向一边的）
one side is bigger or higher than the other side
例：a lopsided planet（歪向一边的星球）

2. manatee（海牛）
a big, gentle sea animal that eats plants
例：a baby manatee（海牛宝宝）

3. atmosphere（大气层）
the layer of air around a planet
例：a puffy atmosphere（蓬松的大气层）

4. journey（旅程）
a long trip from one place to another
例：a long journey across Australia（穿越澳大利亚的长途旅行）
